arxiv-2011-13152.title: True-data Testbed for 5G/B5G Intelligent Network
arxiv-2011-13152.creator: Yongming Huang, Shengheng Liu, Cheng Zhang, Xiaohu You, and Hequan Wu
arxiv-2011-13152.description: Abstract Future beyond fifth-generation (B5G) and sixth-generation (6G) mobile communications will shift from facilitating interpersonal communications to supporting Internet of Everything (IoE), where intelligent communications with full integration of big data and artificial intelligence (AI) will play an important role in improving network efficiency and providing high-quality service.

arxiv-2306-04667.title: Neural Embeddings for Protein Graphs
arxiv-2306-04667.creator: Francesco Ceccarelli, Lorenzo Giusti, Sean B. Holden, Pietro Liò
arxiv-2306-04667.description: Abstract Proteins perform much of the work in living organisms, and consequently the development of efficient computational methods for protein representation is essential for advancing large-scale biological research. Most current approaches struggle to efficiently integrate the wealth of information contained in the protein sequence and structure.

arxiv-2310-05063.title: Pushing the Limits of Pre-training for Time Series Forecasting in the CloudOps Domain
arxiv-2310-05063.creator: Gerald Woo, Chenghao Liu, Akshat Kumar & Doyen Sahoo
arxiv-2310-05063.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Gerald Woo, Chenghao Liu, Akshat Kumar & Doyen Sahoo. Time series has been left behind in the era of pre-training and transfer learning. While research in the fields of natural language processing and computer vision are enjoying progressively larger datasets to train massive models, the most popular time series datasets consist of only tens of thousands of time steps, limiting our ability to study the effectiveness of pre-training and scaling. Recent studies have also cast doubt on the need for expressive models and scale.

arxiv-2402-06378.title: FD-Vision Mamba for Endoscopic Exposure Correction
arxiv-2402-06378.creator: Zhuoran Zheng, Jun Zhang
arxiv-2402-06378.description: Abstract In endoscopic imaging, the recorded images are prone to exposure abnormalities, so maintaining high-quality images is important to assist healthcare professionals in performing decision-making. To overcome this issue, We design a frequency-domain based network, called FD-Vision Mamba (FDVM-Net), which achieves high-quality image exposure correction by reconstructing the frequency domain of endoscopic images.

arxiv-2505-16337.title: Urban transport systems shape experiences of social segregation
arxiv-2505-16337.creator: Yitao Yang, Erjian Liu, Bin Jia, Ed Manley
arxiv-2505-16337.description: Abstract Mobility is a fundamental feature of human life, and through it our interactions with the world and people around us generate complex and consequential social phenomena. Social segregation, one such process, is increasingly acknowledged as a product of one’s entire lived experience rather than mere residential location de2024PNAS ; Cagney2020Annual ; Phillips2021Sociological .

arxiv-2508-05475.title: Outline of the Wang-Zahl proof of the Kakeya conjecture in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3}
arxiv-2508-05475.creator: Larry Guth
arxiv-2508-05475.description: Abstract In the recent preprint [ 5 ] , Hong Wang and Joshua Zahl proved the 3-dimensional Kakeya conjecture, building on previous papers [ 3 ] and [ 4 ] . I am working on digesting and checking the proof.

arxiv-2509-02541.creator: Guyue Hu, Siyuan Song, Jingpeng Sun, Zhe Jin, Chenglong Li, Jin Tang
arxiv-2509-02541.description: Abstract Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) image segmentation is crucial in diagnosing and treating many diseases, such as brain tumors. Existing MRI image segmentation methods mainly fall into a centralized multimodal paradigm, which is inapplicable in engineering non-centralized mix-modal medical scenarios.

arxiv-2602-08244.title: Learning in Context, Guided by Choice: A Reward-Free Paradigm for Reinforcement Learning with Transformers
arxiv-2602-08244.creator: Juncheng Dong, Bowen He, Moyang Guo, Ethan X. Fang, Zhuoran Yang, Vahid Tarokh
arxiv-2602-08244.description: Abstract In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) leverages the in-context learning capabilities of transformer models (TMs) to efficiently generalize to unseen sequential decision-making tasks without parameter updates. However, existing ICRL methods rely on explicit reward signals during pretraining, which limits their applicability when rewards are ambiguous, hard to specify, or costly to obtain.

pmc-13217414.creator: Masaki Nagashima, Ryo Sasaki, Kentaro Tanaka, Hiroyuki Nagita, Masamitsu Suhara, Mitsuru Yagi
pmc-13217414.description: ObjectiveDeep venous thrombosis (DVT) has the potential to develop into life-threatening pulmonary embolism which is a serious complication after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR). Advanced age (≥40 years) is a known risk factor for DVT. Anticoagulation is an effective pharmacological prophylaxis for DVT, but its indications after ACLR have not been established.

pmc-13259728.title: Plant responses to cold stress: molecular and physiological adaptive mechanisms with breeding advances
pmc-13259728.creator: Haixia Li, Lin Cui, Song Liu, Tianhe Zhang, Yuexia Wang, Xiaoxing Wang, Haifang Jiang
pmc-13259728.description: Cold stress is a critical bottleneck that constrains crop cultivation boundaries, reshapes species distribution patterns, and limits yield improvement, directly threatening plant survival and growth. This review systematically analyzes the impacts of cold stress on plants with cold stress as its core research focus.

pmc-13482151.title: Coherent transformation of metal halide perovskites
pmc-13482151.creator: Pinghui Yang, Haokun Shi, Zhen Wang, Shuaijun Yan, Xiliu Wang, Bo Xu, Junbo Wang, Kaidi Liu, Xuan Gao, Wenbo Liu, Fangfang Wang, Lin Zhu, Renzhi Li, Wei Huang, Jianpu Wang
pmc-13482151.description: Metal-halide perovskites offer high optoelectronic performance but translating laboratory efficiencies into controllable, reproducible processes remains challenging. Perovskite crystallization is tracked by in situ multiwavelength absorption to show that coherent, layer-by-layer conversion of low-n intermediates to three-dimensional perovskite, quantified by a transformation index (TI), correlates with device quality.

pmc-13556690.title: 770. Long-Term Clinical Trajectory Following Short-Term Digital Therapeutics in Adolescents with Autism: Preliminary Findings from a Multicenter Expansion Study
pmc-13556690.creator: T Y Choi, S Chang, J Lee
pmc-13556690.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPharmacological treatments for autism spectrum disorder (ASD) primarily target associated behavioral symptoms such as irritability, while core social communication deficits remain insufficiently addressed. Digital therapeutics (DTx) have emerged as scalable, non-pharmacological interventions designed to improve social functioning. NDTx-01 is a mobile-based social skills training (SST) digital therapeutic that previously demonstrated significant short-term improvements in adaptive behavior, as measured by the Korean Vineland Adaptive Behavior Scales (K-VABS), and social responsiveness, assessed by the Social Responsiveness Scale-2 (SRS-2), following a 6-week intervention.
